row.team_price_text: Starting at $299/mo (flat module price, unlimited employee seats)
row.evidence: Payhawk's pricing page says every module includes "SSO / SAML for Okta, Microsoft Entra, GSuite, JumpCloud, and more", but no SCIM endpoint is documented; Okta and Entra ID connect only as Merge-based HR sources ("Payhawk supports integration with Okta through utilizing the Merge API").
row.notes: New row. No SCIM at any tier (absence: pricing page, help-centre index of ~880 English articles, Developer API spec and the Okta/Entra catalogues all searched). Pricing is modular and flat (Travel from $299/mo, Accounts Payable $349, Cards & Expenses $449, Procurement $499, Payhawk Complete by demo), with unlimited employee seats; price also depends on admin/accountant seats, cards and transaction volume, so per-user fields are null. SAML SSO (SP-initiated only, set up with the Implementation Manager) is included in every module. User lifecycle automation is a Payhawk-run directory/HRIS sync through Merge: Okta and Entra ID are offered as "HR" connections that create users from the directory and remove them (freezing cards) when deactivated or terminated; recorded as directory_sync. The Developer API (API key, 15 req/s) has user list/invite/update/remove and team-membership endpoints.

plans.name: Travel
plans.notes: Flat module price; unlimited employee seats.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere on payhawk.com, the help centre index or the Developer API spec. Automated user lifecycle comes from Payhawk-run HRIS/directory sync through Merge (Okta and Entra ID are offered as "HR" connections), not from SCIM.

endpoints.purpose: List all team records within an account
Update member role within a team

webhooks_user_events.notes: The supported event list covers expenses, payments, deposits, suppliers, purchase orders, one-time login requests and expense reports; no user events.

rate_limits.text: 15 requests per second (sliding window); RateLimit and Retry-After headers returned.

limitations.text: Group-level (multi-entity) user endpoint is read-only (GET /api/v3/groups/{groupId}/users); user invite/update/remove are per account.

user_api.notes: Account users endpoints (list/invite/update/remove) plus team membership and team role endpoints. Which modules include API access is not stated on the pricing page.

okta.notes: Not in the OIN (search returns no results). SSO via a custom SAML 2.0 app; Payhawk pulls users from Okta through its Merge-based HR connector (Settings > Integrations > HR), not SCIM.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery app or tutorial (not in the Entra SaaS tutorial index); SSO as a non-gallery app; users pulled into Payhawk via the Merge-based connector.

google.notes: Custom SAML app; no Google Workspace provisioning documented.

onelogin.notes: Per Payhawk's own guide; OneLogin's connector page not loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: Custom SAML App in JumpCloud; no provisioning documented.

fallbacks.other_sync: Payhawk-run HRIS/directory sync via Merge (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, BambooHR, HiBob, Personio, Deel, and Enterprise HRIS add-on for Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, UKG, ADP, Ceridian, Paychex, Paylocity): creates/invites users and removes them when terminated or deactivated in the source.
